interpretation: Recall is relative to the frozen supplied reference set, not all public news.
Candidate pairs, original texts and unique article URLs have different denominators.
Precision uses independent relevance judgments; unjudged results remain in bounds.
Closed-reference accuracy concerns retrieval within that finite labeled corpus only.
No-known-incident controls do not become verified negative entities.
Entity labels describe documented reports or administrative incidents, not guilt or personal risk.
Missing publication dates are retained and make the temporal scope partially unverifiable.
Confidence intervals describe binomial uncertainty, not sample-selection bias.
public_interpretation_notes: URL y hash únicos no equivalen a historias periodísticas independientes; puede haber sindicación o páginas regionales de la misma nota.
f1_reviewed_precision_and_frozen_reference_recall es una media armónica híbrida de universos distintos; no es el F1 convencional del clasificador.
Las proporciones Wilson son marginales; no corrigen selección dirigida, correlación entre URLs ni desconocimiento de la verdad.
Las descargas de referencias conocidas no acreditan descubrimiento por nombre.
source_limitations: Gold reference URLs were explicitly supplied to this closed-corpus collection; these are reading/classification metrics, not discovery/search recall.
Publication-date overlay uses only metadata from conserved original HTML; missing dates remain unknown.
